rules: H6c (Ahmed, 15 Nov 2026): the team and hand-off ownership. kind guest (the default) — a guest conversation through the real engine; «[staff] …» is a staff reply (the conversation is then «مع موظف»: the assistant silent), «[wait:N]» lets N minutes pass (the branch's «عودة المساعد» is 15); while «بانتظار موظف» the assistant keeps answering what it can (answer), and a further thing it cannot answer joins the same hand-off (handoff_add). kind staff_chat — a message from a staff (who: staff) or management (who: report) number: the colleague chat (prompts.md §9), graded by code (no guest data, numbers only from the FACTS) and by a cheap grader for the tone. kind team — the alert rules in code (_shared/hub/staff.ts): who gets the alert, the escalation, the test switch. The guest conversations are also test-lab items (tags conversation, h6c).
